title: What percentage of EUR-paying customers had a total yearly gas consumption
question: What percentage of EUR-paying customers had a total yearly gas consumption exceeding the average yearly consumption of all CZK-paying customers in 2012?

    SELECT 
        c.XCL_001 AS customer_id,
        c.XCL_003 AS currency,
        SUM(ym.XCL_021) AS yearly_consumption
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.XCL_001 = ym.XCL_019
    WHERE SUBSTRING(ym.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2012'
    GROUP BY c.XCL_001, c.XCL_003
),
czk_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(yearly_consumption) AS avg_czk_consumption
    FROM customer_yearly_consumption
    WHERE currency = 'CZK'
)
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ccc.currency = 'EUR' AND ccc.yearly_consumption > caz.avg_czk_consumption THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN ccc.currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS percentage
FROM customer_yearly_consumption ccc
CROSS JOIN czk_avg caz
